tabs.tab1_description:
South Sea Pearl gemstones are formed as a defense mechanism of the Oysters, Clams, and Mussels. When a foreign body or an irritant enters the oyster shell, clam or mussel, the soft tissues or rather the mantle of the living shelled mollusk, it automatically secretes a smooth crystalline substance called 'nacre' to form a coating on the irritant because it is not able to dispel it. This natural process goes on for years to form the natural Pearl stones. It is a misconception that a grain of sand or dirt is the cause of irritation which causes the nacre to be secreted in a mollusk shell. Rather it is considered to be a microorganism or parasite which mostly causes this phenomenon to set in the mantle of the shelled mollusk.

South Sea pearls are prized gemstones known for their beauty and benefits. Pearls promote emotional well-being and bring calm and balance. They symbolize purity, integrity, loyalty, sincerity, and trust. South Sea pearls enhance wisdom, creativity, and connection with the sea and nature. They have a soothing effect on the mind and can help with stress and anxiety. South Sea pearls are treasured for their elegance and potential to promote inner harmony and emotional serenity.

South Sea Pearl gemstone is a combination of calcium carbonate and a complex protein called conchiolin, with a hardness from 2.5 to 4.5 on the Mohs scale. The value of natural found Pearls are made when an unwanted object or irritant gets into the oyster's shell and gets stuck there during the pearl-making process. This irritant in the form of sand or dust from the ocean triggers the oyster's defense system, which makes it secrete layers of mucus. The secretion, also called nacre, turns into a natural pearl over time. Thus, the value and quality of a natural pearl are based on the quality of the nacre. 

South Sea Pearls are cultured pearls in which a small shell-like catalyst is used to accelerate the production of nacre and produce pearls that are almost perfectly round. In these Pearls, the object or irritant is put inside the creature with human help. Cultured pearls are prized for their beauty and luster, as well as their perfectly rounded shape.

South Sea Pearls enhance wisdom, creativity, and connection with the sea and nature. They have a soothing effect on the mind and can help with stress and anxiety. South Sea pearls are treasured for their elegance and potential to promote inner harmony and emotional serenity. Symbolizing virtue, South Sea Pearls are appreciated for its smooth texture and color. Thus it is called the "stone of reliability". 

The most popular use of the elegant South Sea Pearl gems is in making jewelry, which has been worn by women down the ages and is considered the jewelry of the goddesses. Pearl gemstones have been patronized by the Royalty and the wealthy strata of society since olden times. Pearl stones have an important use in Vedic Astrology for healing certain aspects if reflected in the birth chart of the native.

South Sea Pearls have been valued as gemstones due to their lustrous and perfectly rounded appearance. South Sea Pearl jewelry or the incorporation of pearls into accessories can add a touch of elegance to one's personal style.

South Sea Pearls are regarded as symbols of love, chastity, and purity. It is believed that they improve romantic relationships, nurture love, and strengthen emotional bonds. Pearls can be given as gifts to express affection and strengthen relationships.

The pearl of the south sea is said to possess a nurturing and healing energy that aids in the body's natural healing process. They promote inner peace and balance emotions, consequently, releasing stress and overwhelming states of mind.

South Sea pearls are also grown in the warm waters of the South Pacific, primarily in Australia, Indonesia, the Philippines, and Myanmar.

South Sea pearls have a luxurious, creamy white color with commonly a silver undertone. Some have a golden hue to them. The variety of these natural and lustrous colors are the result of specific oyster species.

South Sea cultured pearls have excellent clarity, with few to no visible surface imperfections or blemishes. This high level of clarity is due to their cultivation in the relatively pristine and less polluted waters of the South Pacific. The smooth and lustrous surface of these pearls allows their natural beauty and stunning luster to shine through.

Minor flaws can still happen on the surface of South Sea pearls, but they are usually small and don't have a big effect on their overall beauty and value. They are highly valued for their high quality and nearly flawless appearance.

How to Identify or Test Original & Authentic South Sea Pearl?

The best way to check the authenticity of South Sea Pearl is by getting a Lab tested report from a reputed laboratory. Rudra Centre only deals with Vedic Astrology approved gemstones that are natural, untreated, and unheated. All our pearls are certified by reputable labs like GIA, GLI, IGI and IGITL. 
Look for flaws along with inclusions. Use a magnifying glass with at least 10x magnification to examine the Pearl carefully. Look for specks and blemishes, as they form with minute particles of other material. These flaws are strong evidence that a Pearl is genuine. Lab-created (fake) Pearl have no inclusions of this nature, and neither do natural Pearl, but if you find flaws, then your Pearl is genuine. 
Examine the gemstone for air bubbles. Essentially, lab-created Pearl are glass that has undergone a process similar to that which forms natural Pearl. Since they are made of glass, they retain miniscule air bubbles after formation. If there are bubbles within the Pearl, it is not genuine. Be sure to inspect your Pearl from every angle by turning it over. There is a possibility that bubbles of air will only be evident from a single angle. 
Look at how light is reflected by the Pearl. Turn off all the lights and shine your flashlight on the Pearl. If it is genuine, it will only reflect light of the same hue as itself. If it is a fake, made of glass, it will reflect colors other than the natural color of the gem.

Never use an ultrasonic or steam cleaner to clean South Sea pearls. 
It is safe to use soapy, warm water for thorough cleaning on occasion. If the pearls are strung, the string must be completely dry prior to wearing them. 
After each use, it is best to wipe South Sea pearls with a very soft, clean cloth for routine maintenance.
